show.description: A powerful government minister survives an assassination attempt but urgently needs a heart transplant. With flights grounded, the only hope is a brilliant yet controversial surgeon who has just been reinstated. He has only 190 minutes to transport a donor heart and save the minister’s life. But the mission turns dangerous when influential people, driven by ego and revenge, begin sabotaging his journey. Every delay pushes the clock closer to death.
